### The Doctrine of the Mean on sincerity

The Doctrine of the Mean (Warring States period, c. 4th – 3rd century BCE) approaches sincerity within Confucianism. The title resists translation in a way that matters. Zhōng is not the compromise between two positions, and yōng is not a mediocre middle. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets sincerity most directly—useful for searches such as “the doctrine of the mean quotes on sincerity.”
